insight: A VS Code fork from ByteDance that bundles frontier models with no API key, though its telemetry has drawn enterprise privacy scrutiny.
name: Trae
tagline: Free AI-native IDE with an autonomous build mode.
description: VS Code-based AI IDE from ByteDance whose Builder/SOLO agent plans tasks, edits across files, runs commands, and previews results. Bundles access to frontier models like Claude, GPT, Gemini, and DeepSeek without requiring your own API key, on free and paid usage tiers.

modelSupport.notes: Bundles frontier models without a user-supplied key; usage metered across tiers.

edge: Free to start and undercuts paid AI-IDE rivals on cost, since model access is bundled rather than billed per token.
pros: Frontier models bundled, no API key

references.title: ByteDance AI IDE Trae telemetry continues even after opt-out
